keyPriority.title: Key Priority and Fallback
keyPriority.priorityDesc: OpenRouter always prioritizes using your provider keys when available.
keyPriority.fallbackDesc: By default, if your key encounters a rate limit or failure, OpenRouter will fall back to using shared OpenRouter credits.
keyPriority.alwaysUseDesc: You can configure individual keys with "Always use this key" to prevent any fallback to OpenRouter credits. When this option is enabled, OpenRouter will only use your key for requests to that provider. This may result in rate limit errors if your key is exhausted, but ensures all requests go through your account.
keyPriority.neverUseCreditsDesc1: If you wish to never use shared OpenRouter credits for a model, you must
keyPriority.neverUseCreditsDesc2: both specify "Always use this key" and pin the provider
